measures.id: Warren City Proposed Ordinance (Council Pay Raises)
measures.title: Proposed Ordinance – City of Warren: Rescind Council Pay Raises
measures.summary: Asks Warren voters whether to pass an ordinance that would immediately rescind and replace the pay raises for Warren City Council. It would also eliminate all future automatic pay increases for elected officials.
measures.yesMeans: The ordinance passes: the council pay raises are rescinded and replaced, and future automatic increases for elected officials end.
measures.noMeans: The ordinance does not pass, and current pay arrangements stay in place.
